While traders brace for continued challenges for the rupee, possible dollar inflows could offer a cushion.

Traders are anticipating rate hikes, with major banks revising their forecasts. title: Global Market | European shares slip on Fed hike bets, tech drag

title: Slowing rural incomes could weigh on consumer demand: Dhananjay Sinha

Rising inflation, reverse migration from cities, and an uncertain monsoon threaten to dampen rural demand.  Consumer companies may face squeezed purchasing power as prices climb and real wages stagnate, potentially impacting their profitability and volume growth in upcoming quarters.
